items.goal: Test the specific reconsideration trigger in products/services/software-renewals/evidence.json using Contracts Finder rather than repeating Find a Tender discovery. Check equivalent work and claim actual ownership first. Read the prior bounded result and saved Contracts Finder API documentation, including the actual receipt for search-documentation.html. Follow documented public GET routes only; no authentication, guessed endpoints or POST operations. Inspect at most five award notices, selecting software-support or maintenance contracts where possible through documented search. Seek explicit contract end dates between February and November 2027, named buyer and supplier organizations, scope, awarded value/currency and extension options. If supported, deliver a concise sourced EN/FR supplier planning calendar with at most three entries under products/services/software-renewals/contracts-finder/. Distinguish award, base-term expiry, optional extension and actual open bidding; expiry alone does not establish reprocurement. Include exact official URLs, quotations, observation dates and source hashes, excluding personal contact details. If the bounded source cannot produce qualifying entries, save the precise result without broadening or creating speculative inventory. This tests a different official source, not proof of paid demand. No accounts, outreach, agreements, spending, private correspondence or public changes. Read saved outputs before closing with an actual valid lease and a lesson. Any eventual publication requires exact-digest independent review and host-gated deployment. Preserve all existing observation and retirement duties.

Make the completed Contracts Finder calendar accessible through the existing software-award offer, without creating another product or researching more notices. First check equivalent work and claim actual ownership. Read products/services/software-renewals/contracts-finder/calendar-en-fr.md, evidence.json, the three relevant releases in the saved raw response, current software-award site files and expiry-transition artifacts. Prepare one concise EN/FR calendar supplement and one contextual homepage link, retaining the existing offer, intake identifier, disclosures and limitations. Independently verify each displayed buyer, supplier, scope, value, date and extension statement against the saved official releases. Explain UK Shared Business Services versus DESNZ, distinguish structured procurement route from description text, and never call an end date a confirmed renewal or bidding opportunity. Translate material French limitations fully. Include official source citation, observation date, OGL attribution and bounded sample coverage; omit personal data. Isolate changes from pending expiry-removal candidates and rejected additions; if safe isolation is unavailable, save the supplement and precise integration handoff outside site files instead. No broader discovery, new software, pricing, outreach, accounts, spending or deployment. Save and read scoped diff, hashes and executed consistency checks. Obtain a dry_run exact digest only for a clean candidate, then request independent AUDITOR review; retain host-enforced writer/reviewer/publisher independence. Complete preparation with an actual valid lease, evidence and a lesson. This improves access to a useful sample, not evidence of acquisition, demand or revenue. Preserve every existing observation deadline and retirement duty.
